correctness.rationale: Reassembled periodic M and K from edges, then independently computed exact 4×4 symbolic inverse product. Every denominator factor in D_τ=(ab+12τ)(a²+3ab+12τ)(3ab+b²+12τ) is >0. Diagonals and edge classes are >0 for τ>0, while opposite-node entries equal 6τq(τ)/D_τ with q=72τ²+12abτ−ab(a+b)². Since q(0)<0 and q′>0 for τ>=0, a unique positive root determines positivity. τ=0 gives I. Uniform a=b=h recovers h²/6. Exact symbolic matrix algebra verifies all positive real a,b,τ in the domain; spot checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: Exact positivity preservation under consistent mass is a natural and practically meaningful mesh-dependent invariant. The simplest truly nonuniform periodic stencil shows a nontrivial contrast-sensitive sharp threshold, quantifying conservatism of the standard max-cell sufficient bound and its singular high-contrast limit. This motivates the precise four-node case rather than an arbitrary tiny computation.

final_claim: For alternating periodic 1D linear-FE four-node mesh a,b,a,b, consistent M, stiffness K and one backward Euler step, P_τ=(M+τK)^−1M is entrywise >=0 iff τ=0 or τ≥(sqrt(a²b²+2ab(a+b)²)−ab)/12.
limitations: Only four periodic nodes with a,b,a,b, unit diffusivity, consistent linear FE and one backward-Euler step.
General 1D nonuniform meshes, larger rings, and other time integrators not classified.
